interactions.source: case 'SERVICE_AREAS': return <NameListStep title="Service areas" initial={runtime.status?.intakeProfile?.serviceAreas || ['Main Bar']} existing={recordsOf(snapshot,'outlets')} onCreate={async names => { const existingNames=new Set(recordsOf(runtime.snapshot,'outlets').map(x=>String(x.name).trim().toLowerCase())); for (const name of names) if(!existingNames.has(name.toLowerCase())) await save('outlets', crypto.randomUUID(), { name, propertyId:'property', type:'BAR', active:true, defaultStockLocationId:null }); await complete(active,'STOCK_LOCATIONS'); }} />;

interactions.source: case 'STOCK_LOCATIONS': return <NameListStep title="Stock locations" initial={runtime.status?.intakeProfile?.stockAreas || ['Main Store','Bar Store']} existing={recordsOf(snapshot,'stockLocations')} onCreate={async names => { const before=recordsOf(runtime.snapshot,'stockLocations'); const existingNames=new Set(before.map(x=>String(x.name).trim().toLowerCase())); const created:string[]=[]; for (const name of names) if(!existingNames.has(name.toLowerCase())) { const id=crypto.randomUUID(); created.push(id); await save('stockLocations',id,{ name, propertyId:'property', type:name.toLowerCase().includes('fridge')?'FRIDGE':'STORE' }); } const first=before[0]?.id || created[0]; if(!first) throw new Error('Create at least one stock location'); for (const outlet of recordsOf(runtime.snapshot,'outlets')) await save('outlets',outlet.id,{ ...outlet, defaultStockLocationId:first }); await complete(active,'CATALOG'); }} />;

interactions.source: case 'CATALOG': return <FirstCatalogStep snapshot={snapshot} onSave={async input => { const stockId=crypto.randomUUID(); await save('stockItems',stockId,{ name:input.stockName,code:input.code,baseUnit:input.baseUnit,averageUnitCost:input.cost,currentStock:{},barcode:input.stockBarcode,scanUnitQuantity:input.scanUnitQuantity }); const outletIds=recordsOf(runtime.snapshot,'outlets').map(x=>x.id); await save('products',crypto.randomUUID(),{ name:input.productName,code:input.code,price:input.price,category:input.category,routeTo:'BAR',outletIds,stockItemId:stockId,portionVolume:input.portionVolume,taxClassId:'A_STANDARD',favorite:true,barcode:input.barcode,portions:[],modifiers:[],recipeIngredients:[] }); await complete(active,'RECIPES_PORTIONS'); }} products={recordsOf(snapshot,'products')} />;
